description: Frictionless Table Schema of Platform/common/vectors/probe-tables.tsv. Every field is a raw string: no type coercion. Lexical constraints only where the header of the form states them; the JSON of case and cells, the CEL of skip and the meaning of native stay with wire.md «P/01 write-checks transport».

fields.name: table
fields.description: The field table of the envelope: the file name of the probe table, the last component of source.

fields.name: source
fields.description: A repository-relative path of the probe table; its last component equals table (checked with the form, not by this schema).

fields.name: cells
fields.description: A JSON object from the wire cell names to column or lines sources.

fields.name: skip
fields.description: CEL over row: map<string,string>; false — every row is executed.
